Your first key

Plug in your fapico2, click Connect, and it asks for a touch whenever something needs signing.

Generate key

Pick an empty slot. Generation happens on the device and needs a touch. A generated key can only be removed with Delete — there is no undo.

Import key

Validated here, never stored, never logged. The device touch moves it onto the board.

Export key

Export shows the secret scalar once, in this window only. It is never stored. Anyone who reads it owns the identity.
